name: transcript-found42
description: Local web app that turns meeting transcripts into Google Tasks and Gmail drafts (drafts only, never sent).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && npm run build --workspace @transcript-tasks/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @transcript-tasks/shared && tsx watch apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace @transcript-tasks/tests
